worldcombat.skill.focusblast.summary: Stand still, compress your energy inward, then hurl an unstable blast: the heaviest special hit in the family, knocking the target back and possibly lowering its Sp. Def by 1 stage. The fuller the power, the more it can veer off; higher levels keep it steadier.
worldcombat.skill.focusblast.use.0: Unleash the heaviest hit on a planted target from range
worldcombat.skill.focusblast.use.1: Shove a point-blank foe or someone behind cover away
worldcombat.skill.focusblast.use.2: Open a fight by removing a chunk of health
worldcombat.skill.focusblast.description: It can veer up to %1$s degrees off the line (the more it veers, the likelier a miss) and knocks the target back %2$s blocks on a hit.
On a hit there is a %1$s chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by %2$s; while lowered it takes more special damage, until the target disengages or its stat stages are reset.
It charges for %1$s (holding still; interruptible, and an interruption costs no PP), then flies at %2$s blocks per tick up to %3$s blocks with a %4$s block trace radius; unleash is currently %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.focusblast.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.focusblast.growth.0: From level %1$s the blast rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
On: power ×1.12 but scatter ×1.5 and +4 ticks cooldown — fuller power, more likely to veer, for hammering a planted target. Off: tighter and steadier, base scatter, for staying on a mobile target.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it start charging from further away.
Inside this distance it lowers this move's priority, so it does not stand still to charge in a foe's face. Set to 0 to charge even point-blank.
On: targets with a high health ratio rank higher, since the heaviest hit is worth most on a full-health foe. Off: every target ranks the same.
